verdict.rationale: Docs and GitHub explicitly state LLM-based extraction supports all LLMs, both open-source and proprietary, and the project is fully open source with no forced API keys, implying local/self-hosted LLM backends can be plugged in for extraction. Missing for 10: explicit step-by-step docs/config example showing pointing extraction at a local model (e.g., Ollama endpoint) and independent hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
